lines.text: Count by tens from zero, then look between the marks.
Tap the line where 300 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 4 point 4 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 5 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where negative 20 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where negative 3 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where one third goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where the square root of 138 goes. Then launch!
The marks count by 25. Tap the line where negative 21 goes. Then launch!
